+package javafx.beans.property;
+
+import java.util.function.Function;
+
+public final class DeclaringClassCacheShim {
+
+    private DeclaringClassCacheShim() {}
+
+    public static Class<?> computeIfAbsent(ReadOnlyProperty<?> property,
+                                           String propertyName,
+                                           Function<ReadOnlyProperty<?>, Class<?>> supplier) {
+        return DeclaringClassCache.computeIfAbsent(property, propertyName, supplier);
+    }
+}
